name: Admin Document Drag Organize
description: Admin organizes by drag-and-drop: dragging a document card/row onto a sidebar folder moves it (PATCH /api/documents/:id/update/ folder_id), and dragging a folder onto a breadcrumb/sidebar folder re-parents it (PATCH /api/document-folders/:id/update/). The modal-based move path is covered by admin-document-move-folder; the drag path is not.
knownGaps: Drag interactions untested (fragile in Playwright; needs dispatchEvent-based DnD). Registered 2026-07-16 audit.
